page.layout: One page of text: a continuation of a Latin verse stanza at the top, then a French poem with a Latin version below it, all in one column. Catchword at the lower right. Faint marginal print on the right side is too damaged to read and is noted only.

main_text.p: Persas rebellis Gracia contudit. Sed iura cunctis Roma potentior Orbi subacto cum dedisset Viribus ipsa suis subacta est. Si fixa clavis regna adamantinis Currente rerum sic pereunt vice, Sperare quis vitam hic in horas Perpetuam moribundus ausit?
main_text.head: XIII. GAL.
main_text.p: ORFEVRE, taille moy vne boule bien ronde, Creuse,& pleine de vent,l'image de ce Mõde: Et qu'vne grand' beauté la vienne reuestir, Autant que ton burin peut tromper & mentir, En y representant des fruicts de toute guise: Et puis tout à l'entour efcris ceste deuise: Ainsi roule tousiours ce Monde deceuant, Qui n'a fruicts qu'en peinture, & fondez sur le vent.
main_text.head: LAT.
main_text.p: PRÆSENTIS cui quæris imaginem? Pictor rotundum pinge, precor, globum, Intus cavatum, quem furentes Vsque ferant rapiantq; venti, Fronti venusta cui decus addito Quantum arte possis eximia memor:

page.notes: Right margin: faint traces of printing, illegible, not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "Mõde" and "Monde" as printed; "Ainsi"/"sur" long s rendered as plain s. The line "Hunc" at the foot is the catchword, set in italic at the lower right. Top of page: the stanza begins mid-poem and is marked cont="true".
